description: This Java class 'TrackingCodeEvents' contains static methods for handling tracking code logic within a web application, including URL parameter checks, cookie management, visit association, and order tracking related to marketing tracking codes.

classes.name: TrackingCodeEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing tracking codes, cookies, and visit associations in a web application.

methods.name: checkTrackingCodeUrlParam
methods.description: Checks for 'autoTrackingCode' or 'atc' URL parameters, retrieves the corresponding TrackingCode, and processes it if found.

methods.name: checkPartnerTrackingCodeUrlParam
methods.description: Handles 'ptc' URL parameter for partner-managed tracking codes, creating default codes if necessary, and processes them.

methods.name: processTrackingCode
methods.description: Associates a tracking code with the current visit, sets cookies, session attributes, and handles redirection if specified.

methods.name: checkTrackingCodeCookies
methods.description: Attaches tracking code information to the visit based on existing tracking code cookies.

methods.name: checkAccessTrackingCode
methods.description: Validates 'autoTrackingCode' or 'atc' cookies for access control, returning success or redirecting to protect.

methods.name: removeAccesTrackingCodeCookie
methods.description: Removes cookies ending with '_ACCESS' to revoke access codes.

methods.name: makeTrackingCodeOrders
methods.description: Creates a list of TrackingCodeOrder entities based on cookies for order association.
